definitions.FPR_j: time of false alarms of source j (not intersecting any crisis +-10 s) / time outside crises, window only
definitions.TPR_j: time inside crises during which source j is in alarm / total crisis time
definitions.d_false_s: mean duration of a false alarm
definitions.episodes: union of overlapping false alarms of one patient; n_sources = distinct sources in the episode
definitions.c_art_a: share of false alarm time that lies in episodes with all 4 sources
definitions.c_art_b: share of false alarm time that lies in episodes with >= 2 sources
